part.text: The interfaces are already defined in `interface.go`, so I just need to implement the concrete types in `paasio.go`.

All tests pass, including with the race detector (`go test -race -count=1`).

Implementation in `paasio.go`:

- **`readCounter`** and **`writeCounter`** each wrap their underlying `io.Reader`/`io.Writer` and track total bytes (`n int64`) and operation count (`nops int`), guarded by a `sync.Mutex`.
- `Read`/`Write` call the wrapped object, then update both counters inside a single critical section — this keeps bytes and op counts consistent, which the `testReadCountConsistency`/`testWriteCountConsistency` tests require (they assert `nops == n / numBytes` at any instant).
- **`readWriteCounter`** embeds `*readCounter` and `*writeCounter`, so it satisfies `ReadWriteCounter` by composition; `NewReadWriteCounter` builds both from the same `io.ReadWriter`.

The interfaces themselves (`ReadCounter`, `WriteCounter`, `ReadWriteCounter`) were already defined in `interface.go`, so no changes were needed there, and no new files were created.
